channel.title: Chuhee Lee — Independent Research
channel.description: Benchmarks, comparisons and research reports on AI, mobility and experience: time and attention on the move. New editions and refreshes.

item.title: Physical AI and the Rider’s Cabin
item.description: Research report, October 2026 edition (data as of 13 Oct 2026). What physical AI means, the main players across the stack, the most-used products and services, and how it reaches the car, with the cabin and rider experience as the main lens.

item.title: Agentic AI and the Consumer: 2027 Outlook
item.description: Research report, October 2026 edition (data as of 11 Oct 2026). How agentic AI changes what consumers trust, delegate, buy and feel across retail, travel, finance and mobility, with a US, EU and China comparison.

item.title: Mobility Product Outlook 2026–2031
item.description: Research report, October 2026 edition (data as of 11 Oct 2026). How consumer electronics and rising customer expectations are redefining the car: a twelve-dimension product-definition framework, robotaxi cabins and a ranking of fifteen technologies.

item.title: In-Car AI Assistant Benchmark
item.description: Benchmark, October 2026 edition (data as of 11 Oct 2026). Twenty-one in-car assistants scored on seven capability dimensions and on who controls the stack, with use-case evidence and a dated watch list. Next refresh mid-January 2027.

item.title: Mega Trends Outlook 2040
item.description: Research report, October 2026 edition (data as of 1 Oct 2026). Seven forces reshaping 2026–2040, scored on impact, certainty, speed and breadth, with interaction map, scenarios and wildcards.
